fields.description: Issue of Miami Life (Vol. 6, No. 16) dated May 12, 1928. Prominent coverage includes commentary on the Charles (Charlie) Haynes trial and a manslaughter verdict in the killing of Policeman Frank Beckham; editorials criticizing Florida Power & Light (“Little Nell”) and public-utility propaganda and rates; discussion of post-Shrine Convention business impacts and advice for the upcoming Elks’ convention; and an editorial urging financial support and possible renaming/reorganization for the University of Miami. Includes letters to the editor on a city commission recall effort, convention promotion/credit, and Boy Scouts; plus local political advertisements and community notes.
